sourceSummary: The signed-in product catalogue on the Swag Labs demo storefront.

testCases.title: A signed-in shopper reaches the product catalogue directly
preconditions: The shopper is signed in as standard_user
testCases.rationale: Catches a session that is created at sign-in but not honoured on a direct navigation — the shopper gets bounced back to the login form on every deep link.

testCases.title: The catalogue lists its products
preconditions: The shopper is signed in as standard_user
testCases.rationale: Catches an empty catalogue rendering as a valid page: the shell loads, the heading is there, and no product ever appears.

testCases.title: The cart is reachable from the catalogue
preconditions: The shopper is signed in as standard_user
testCases.rationale: Catches the cart route losing the session where the catalogue keeps it, which is how a shopper ends up logged out at checkout.
